newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Inventec June sales down 10.81 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Inventec June sales down 10.81 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan computer maker Inventec Corp said on Monday its sales revenue in June dropped 10.81 percent to T$3.665 billion from T$4.109 billion a year earlier.
The firm's combined sales rose a scant 3.37 percent to T$23.477 billion in the first six months of 1997 from the same period in 1996, the company said in a statement.

Inventec, one of Taiwan's leading makers of monitors and an emerging contender in notebook computers, has lowered its 1997 pre-tax profit forecast by 11.38 percent to T$3.58 billion due to slowing orders for notebook computers.
It also cut its 1997 sales projection by 16.21 percent to T$43.59 billion.
